methodology_note: Corrected after independent evidence-methodology review (schema 38.9b.0 -> 38.9b.1). Import classification and concrete-import behavior are modeled as two separate dimensions rather than one forced six-bucket shape, since an import record and a later behavioral call on it are not naturally mutually exclusive categories of the same thing.

behavior_analysis_of_the_9_concrete_reco.note: bare_reference_unclassified is an explicit third bucket (not a fallback into di_key) for any concrete record whose local binding is neither directly constructed nor passed to resolver.has/resolve. It is 0 today; a future unsupported reference form would surface here rather than being silently classified as safe.

lifecycle.scratch_scan_role: The fresh scratch scan also ran a coarse, NON-receiver-aware name scan (any Call node named start/stop/pause/resume anywhere in a file that imports TradingEngine) purely as non-authoritative diagnostic corroboration; it found 0 hits, consistent with the committed test, but a name-based scan cannot prove the call's receiver is actually a TradingEngine instance and is not cited as evidence for this metric.

determinism.note: Corrected (v2) scan/classification script, run twice independently against the committed SHA; canonicalized as sort_keys/indent=2 JSON; both runs byte-identical. Supersedes the schema-38.9b.0 hash 08f0120028ecd2dbe896cbe8fda967071008af827e32877dcd276bb42a3c29ef, which was computed from a scan containing the Issue 1/3 methodology defects.

classification_method_note: AST import/call discovery is static. Concrete-vs-Protocol-vs-ABC-vs-dataclass-vs-Enum symbol classification uses runtime introspection (importlib.import_module + getattr + inspect/dataclasses/enum checks), not name-pattern heuristics. The test suite itself (tests/test_h1_cross_framework_boundary.py) is not purely static for the same reason.
scratch_artifact_note: An earlier scratch debug dump (outside the repository) concatenated `records + concrete_records`, which are overlapping references to the same objects, producing duplicate rows in that debug file only. No permanent metric in this JSON was ever computed from that duplicated dump; all counts here come from the non-duplicated `import_buckets`/`behavior_totals` accumulators, incremented exactly once per unique record. The corrected (v2) scratch scan no longer produces the duplication.
